data.body:
[P2] Finalize admitted instrumentation when the deadline expires

When an invocation expires with a live step, the outer lifecycle race rejects and disposal only cleans up the checkpoint manager. `onInvocationEnd` never runs: the original continuation remains suspended, and this guard prevents dispatch after disposal. Both built-in OTel plugins consequently leave Invocation and attempt spans recording, then discard them without exporting them when the next invocation resets their maps. Add a once-only, bounded instrumentation cleanup path for deadline expiry that reports `RETRYING`, preserves invocation ownership, and leaves user stacks suspended. Cover a timed-out live step with an OTel integration regression.
